content: Pávurubay tu̱choda Véstubay tuunu
Mumurundamiñumatiy savicha̱da Véstu jivyichajomu, sa̱subeda ji̱ta variy Sesaréyamusiy Jerusarí̱muju̱.
Jasiñi̱ ji̱ta ruuti̱jada caserdótevyeda nutyityu̱miy simu, Judíyuveda jarye, jiryatiy jaryi datyavadyeryi, rirya̱tidye tu̱chuta variy jasiñi̱ Pávuru.
Riyasanta̱da ji̱ta variñi̱ japu: “Ya̱jpa̱ni̱ Pávuru Jerusarí̱muju̱.” Riñi jachipiya̱jada ju̱veda sanijyu̱. “Vurya̱jvay saniya̱resiy nú̱ta̱sayu.”
Su̱mutya̱jada ji̱ta japubay variy: “Ne, nu̱tyu tanuvu̱nusi̱numa sani̱cha Sesaréyamu, radye ra̱jiya radyirya sana̱cho̱ day.
Risa̱numa jirya̱jmusa day, jiryatiy jaryi datyavay jiryequebyimusiryi. Jasiñi̱ jirya̱tu̱chunuve vijyo̱mujache sanchiy Pávuru, si̱tenuviy savichaniy tara nta jirye.”

Jadchiy ji̱ta, savichanu̱yadanumatiy japu tarundamu ruusa̱, su̱musa̱da ji̱ta Sesaréyamuju̱ variy. Rata̱rimyusiy ji̱ta sama̱sanuvejada japu cadnadu ma̱sajoncha, su̱pa̱jada variy jadchiy sana̱cho̱ Pávuru.
Jasiñumatiy savicha̱da Pávuru, rityuudiyada Judíyuveda variñi̱, jiryatiy ru̱musa̱da Jerusarí̱musiy. Jasiy rityu̱choda variy va̱cha sanchiy, ne vase rityu̱choda sanchiy variñu̱ndye.

Saniquejada ji̱ta Pávuru variy jiyadaju̱ day: “Tama̱ rañi̱chadeda tarara riñiquejada Judíyuveda, dantyamu̱y ne Ju̱denu nijyu̱ jachipiya̱jo ravyichadeda tara, dantyamu̱y ne Róma ja̱nvay ja̱mu nutyityu̱ ravyichadeda nta tara.”

Sani ra̱ryu̱yada Véstu riyada Judíyuveda, sitaja̱doda variñi̱ Pávuru: “¿Va̱ ji, yasumiryu̱vidye, Jerusarí̱muju̱? jasityi ya̱niquenuve vijyo̱mujache ratyuunura, ra̱jtay variy yiva, chi̱ra ra̱ramirya jiñiquejada, chi̱.”

Su̱mutya̱jada ji̱ta Pávuru variñi̱: “Tama̱ taji rañi̱cha jiyu satuunu cadnadunu̱day, tama̱, jiryatiy sabay ja̱mu nutyityu̱ jiyu day ji; jiyunuma rirya̱jtay riva darya, ratiy ru̱taryu̱y riva day. Tama̱ jiñi datyi̱sa samiñu̱day, tama̱. Tama̱ rañi̱chadeda tara riy Judíyuveda, tama̱.

Ju̱vi̱ dyetya ridyi riva, ramutiy rirya̱tanuvu̱nu diiyada sa̱ra̱ju̱ ray, ne rañi suvu̱rya ru̱veda. Va̱ si̱tenu rani̱cha rityu̱chuta̱da cay, nu̱tyichitya ti̱ ra̱sa̱y mitya ray, rirya̱tanuvu̱nujay mitya ray. Ratyu̱churu̱y vijyo̱mujache, Róma ja̱nvay ja̱mu nutyityu̱ tuunu.”
Satu̱chumu̱yadanumatiy japu Véstu datyavayjsa̱, su̱mutya̱jada ji̱ta variñi̱ Pávuru: “Jiyaru̱tyi ja̱mu nutyityu̱mu, simu ni̱day ya̱jiya.”
Pávurubay ra̱jti̱ nutyityu̱ Acrípabay tuunu
Jadchiy ji̱ta, rajuu rundamimyusiy siti̱jada nutyityu̱ Acrípa Berenísejyu̱tya, Sesaréyamuju̱, nana̱tidye mu̱chuvañuve variñi̱ Véstu jasiy.
Jasiy nanuvicha̱da rajuu rundamicha̱ra̱ju̱. Satu̱choda ji̱ta Véstu jasiy nadiva sanchiy Pávuru: “Jiyuni̱ ti̱qui vanu jiryatiy Védisiy tochichiy tanuvu̱nusi̱ni̱.

Rayasiñumatiy Jerusarí̱mu, rityu̱chusiy caserdótevyeda nutyityu̱miy variy riva, Judíyuveda rimyityumiy jarye tu̱chusiy sanchiy Pávuru. Riyasantasiy variy Pávuruva ray: Ya̱tanuvu̱nu diiyada sa̱ra̱ju̱ni̱.

Ri̱mutya̱jasiy variryi: Ne raju̱tya̱da riy Róma ja̱nvay darya day, rirya̱sa̱je mityani̱, netimyu̱ ne rirya̱tu̱chosiy satu̱chutavay vijyo̱mujache jiñijyu̱ didye, ni̱day ra̱nique jiyadaju̱ day jiryatiy rityu̱chutani̱.
Ramuni̱tiy, riintye̱ryanichiñumatiy Judíyuveda jiyuyu, rata̱rimyusiy ramya̱sasiy jasiy cadnadu ma̱sajoncha, rañatuchiy variñi̱ jiñu vanu.
Rityu̱chusiy vijyo̱mujache Judíyuvedara, tama̱ ju̱veda rani̱cha day, daryani̱ rijechipiya̱tanichirye.
Rani̱day jirya rityu̱chu sadiyada jache, jiryatiy sadatya Ju̱denu jtedamura. Riñi jtay sadiimya̱ Jesús, Pávuru ji̱ta jtay variy: Jnu̱ñu dañi̱.

Dantyamu̱y ne radyetya darya, nu̱tyura vuryi̱dutyara va̱cha niquejada, ramutiy ritaja̱nuni̱ Pávuru: ¿Yasumiryu̱vidye Jerusarí̱muju̱? jasityi ya̱niquenuve vijyo̱mujache, jasityi rirya̱jtay variy yiva chi̱ra ra̱ramirya jiñiquejada.

Sayasanta ji̱ta Pávuru varirye: Ya̱bay tarunda sa̱ra̱ju̱ ray, ra̱tidye tu̱chu ji̱ta vijyo̱mujache variy satuunu Róma ja̱nvay ja̱mu nutyityu̱. Rabemya̱ variy ruumura su̱nu̱tyasa̱da, ri̱pa̱jada sa̱ra̱ju̱, varityi ra̱jpa̱ simu ja̱mu nutyityu̱ni̱.”
Su̱teda ji̱ta Acrípa variy siva Véstu: “¡Nu̱tyichitya ratyuva̱chuta̱date dañi̱cu̱!” Su̱teda ji̱ta Véstu siva: “Ta̱rimyusiñuma, ya̱tuva̱chuti̱ni̱.”

Ratarya rundamu siti̱jada Acrípa Berenísejyu̱tya. Naditi̱jada ji̱ta samiy jdutyasanu̱y, vatajuu ruuti̱jada su̱tarumiy nutyityu̱vedata, vicha̱da nutyityu̱ta jarye. Darya ni̱day rijeyada ti̱ta̱ju̱ ravimu tu̱chujo. Véstu jtedamu riryitya̱jadani̱ Pávuru variy.

Su̱teda ji̱ta japu variy: “Diye ji̱ta, Ja̱mu Nutyityu̱ Acrípa, jiryejerye nutyityu̱veda, jirya̱jti̱ ti̱ta̱ju̱musiy rimu; jiyuni̱ ji̱ta jirya̱diy siva jiñu vanu, sivani̱ riyasanta Judíyuveda ray, jiryatiy Jerusarí̱mu vichavaryi, jiyu vichavay jarye. Riyaro̱vatyaja̱ diye sa̱ra̱ju̱ni̱: Ne saryi jnu̱y ju̱na̱ñu̱day.
Tama̱ rañi jnu̱y su̱vay ti̱, ta̱rivara rirya̱tanuvu̱nu mitya diiyada sa̱ra̱ju̱ni̱. Tapi ramu sava̱ta jidyirya darya ja̱mu nutyityu̱mu jiya̱da day, ramuni̱tiy rañi jachipiya̱ jpa̱jadaju̱ni̱.

Netara jna̱y vase niquejada rimu day, ramutimyu̱ ne ra̱nu̱y nutyityu̱ju̱ra. Ramuni̱tiy riti̱ta jiryetyuva̱chuta̱daju̱ni̱, ya̱tidye tuva̱chu jiirya, Ja̱mu Nutyityu̱ Acrípa. Temusiy jiryitaja̱dodamusiy saryityu̱chu tara, ra̱tidye nu̱y variy ja̱mu nutyityu̱ju̱ra.

Tama̱ samirya rani̱cha rajyu̱, tanuvu̱nusi̱ jpa̱jada simu ja̱mu nutyityu̱, tama̱ tara jna̱y rañi̱cha catera nu̱chara jpa̱sara sisa̱, jasityi ra̱tu̱chu catera nu̱chara, nu̱tyuramu rityanuvu̱nuti jasiñi̱.”
